baselineComparison.samplingStoppedReason: Neither original route reached a comparable timing checkpoint; retained the startup/route errors without modifying baseline or tests.
baselineComparison.interpretation: Navigation expired before either target checkpoint; these are not observations of the original 10-second fixture-response or 15-second SELECT-completion failures. No valid old-versus-new comparison exists; upgrade involvement cannot be excluded.

requestChain.skills: The original repeated browser case intercepts /api/v1/skills/list and fulfills it from fixtures.cjs; no real backend participates.
requestChain.sql: The same browser harness intercepts all API requests, including /api/v1/editor/db/tables. db-editor.tsx supplies in-memory schema/table/column metadata to the completion service. The timed event is SELECT becoming visible after typing SEL and triggering completion, involving the frontend plugin/worker; it is not a real SQL query or a backend response interval.
requestChain.normalApplicationLimit: Normal application use loads table metadata through an API; the no-real-backend statement is limited to these recorded fixture tests.

upgradedReference.comparisonLimit: Each series has 20 samples from the existing 40 case executions. There are zero comparable old-baseline samples. This is not a causal benchmark, and neither runtime defaults nor cold/warm design were changed to manufacture comparability.
